notes: Every number is an integer in the milli-units Units documents: a quantity of 3600000 is 3,600 units, a work amount of 1600 is 1.6 work, an energy of 4800 is 4.8 MW. There is no float anywhere in this format, which is why the loader rejects a fractional literal outright. Every file listed here must exist: a catalog field with no file is a field the loader cannot load.
